mapper.select: select * from wallet_bank_card where wallet_account_id = #{walletAccountId} and status = 1 order by is_default desc, id asc
select * from wallet_bank_card where id = #{id} and status = 1 limit 1
select * from wallet_bank_card where card_no = #{cardNo} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into wallet_bank_card (wallet_account_id, bank_name, card_holder, card_no, card_no_mask, card_type, balance, is_default, status, bind_time, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user) values (#{walletAccountId}, #{bankName}, #{cardHolder}, #{cardNo}, #{cardNoMask}, #{cardType}, #{balance}, #{isDefault}, #{status}, #{bindTime}, now(), now(), #{createUser}, #{updateUser})
mapper.update: update wallet_bank_card set is_default = 0, update_user = #{updateUser}, update_time = now() where wallet_account_id = #{walletAccountId} and status = 1
update wallet_bank_card set is_default = 1, update_user = #{updateUser}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and wallet_account_id = #{walletAccountId} and status = 1
